prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Refine the COPPER Z line in the provided clean C1-derived app icon. Produce ONE standalone candidate.
LOCKED invariants: the fog-white rounded-square tile, subtle pale gray edge, restrained copper #d4873b and teal #2f9e8d palette, frontal view, four separated ascending rounded teal bars, overall size and clean shallow-relief style. No dark theme, no recoloring.
CRITICAL BAR FILL: all FOUR bars must remain solid UNSEGMENTED TEAL from bottom to rounded top. ZERO pale, mint or white top caps. ZERO stacked segments or horizontal seams. No pale rectangular cap or white glossy patch may appear anywhere on a bar. Preserve total bar heights where practical; if necessary adjust bar spacing slightly to leave air below the trend line, but never cut bars into parts.
Only explore the Z's geometry. It remains formed by the chart's top benchmark guide, rising diagonal trend line, and horizontal bottom baseline. Four teal bars must remain recognizable as usage statistics. Keep the lower horizontal line as the bar baseline. Graceful natural soft Z, not a rigid pasted font glyph, no lightning bolt, no unrelated symbols.
Use restrained optical curves and rounded terminals. No heavy extrusion or shiny plastic. Single centered icon occupies about 78% of square image width, opaque fog #f3f5f2 backdrop, no text/captions/numbers/grid/watermark.
Specific geometry variation:
Create a two-weight but SAME COLOR copper Z. The rising diagonal trend is a softly rounded medium-weight line, while the upper horizontal benchmark rail and bottom horizontal baseline are much finer, approximately 40% of the diagonal's thickness. Make the weight transitions graceful at rounded corners, not chunky joints. No dots. Diagonal straight with gentle easing into each corner. The eye should read a usage trend first; the thin top and bottom guides reveal a more understated Z second. The fine baseline still clearly supports all four solid teal bars. Same fog-white tile and same teal/copper colors, no other changes.
production_notes: Vector interpretation preserves the selected thick diagonal, thin horizontal rails, four uninterrupted teal bars and fog-white tile. PNG exports are rendered from the SVG.
